comments.creator: user1@redhat.com
comments.text:
Description of problem:
After an ungraceful OSD shutdown (power loss or SIGKILL), the OSD process leaks memory on restart during recovery. The BlueStore cache grows unbounded.

Version-Release number of selected component:
ceph-18.2.4-1.el9cp

How reproducible:
Always

Steps to Reproduce:
1. Start cluster with 3 OSDs
2. Write 100GB of data
3. Kill OSD.0 with SIGKILL
4. Restart OSD.0
5. Monitor RSS memory during recovery

Actual results:
Memory grows from 4GB to 32GB+ during recovery

Expected results:
Memory should stay bounded by bluestore_cache_size

comments.creator: user2@redhat.com
comments.text:
Confirmed on RHCS 7.1. The issue is in BlueStore::_do_remove_collection() — the cache entries for removed collections are not being evicted during recovery. This causes the cache to grow without bound.

Workaround: set bluestore_cache_autotune=false and bluestore_cache_size_ssd=4294967296 to cap at 4GB.
